create TABLE copy_into_table1(
     Dealer_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Model_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Branch_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Date_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Units_Sold BIGINT,
    Revenue BIGINT
)
WITH(
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN
)


-- Loading DATA
COPY INTO copy_into_table1(
    Dealer_ID,
    Model_ID,
    Branch_ID,
    Date_ID,
    Units_Sold,
    Revenue 
)
FROM 'https://databdataftrial.dfs.core.windows.net/synapse/ext_cetas/'
WITH(
    FILE_TYPE = 'PARQUET',
    CREDENTIAL = (IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity')
)
